note: The Venture Anatomy Matrix (EE-157), sibling of the Product Anatomy Matrix: the venture's architecture description in the sense of ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022. Each sub-matrix is a model that names the record types holding it, so the matrix copies nothing; each viewpoint frames a reader's concerns and selects the sub-matrices its view reads. Regulation S-K items are the coverage check: every item a company would disclose maps to at least one sub-matrix. The strategy function owns the matrix itself; each sub-matrix is owned by the function the data model gives its record type. packages/naive/src/engine/venture-anatomy.ts resolves it for a venture.
